Commentary.Commentary: The star of the show and centurion Shimron Hetmyer is caught on the sidelines for an interview. He says that he is feeling good after his ton. Thanks his family and friends for their support. On the conditions, he mentions that it was good as the ball was coming on well. Reckons that he is adjusting to the balance between white and red-ball cricket. Ends by saying he is happy with the total on the board.

India will be disappointed to say the least. Their bowlers leaked plenty of runs and the fielding standards weren't up to the mark either. Barring Chahal, who took 3 wickets and was economical too, rest all went for runs despite their wickets, especially Shami. 323 isn't a target which isn't achievable, but it will really challenge the Indian batting line-up. We surely have a game on our hands here. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

Windies have a challenging total on the board and can give the Indians a real run for their money with this. It was largely the Shimron Hetmyer show today. Losing the debutant Hemraj early didn't dent the scoring rate as Kieran Powell and Hope kept it going. Both got dismissed in quick succession after putting on a good stand, but then Hetmyer came in and took the game away as he put up two terrific partnerships with Rovman Powell and Holder and scored a masterful ton. Some late runs added towards the end by Bishoo and Roach, useful ones of course, saw Windies reach 322 and be in a commanding position.
Full in length, attacking the stumps, Roach backs a long way away and smacks it through the covers. The sweeper cuts it off and keeps the batsmen down to two. With that, WINDIES FINISH ON 322/8!
Drills this full length ball through the covers and gets a single.
Wide! Too far down the leg side, Dhoni can't stop it cleanly and the batsmen take a run. Wide signalled as well.

FOUR! Umesh is unlucky here. Spears in a good yorker on off, Roach somehow manages to get an inside edge which goes past the leg stump. It races away to the fine leg fence and that will be another boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Hits this with hard hands through the covers and takes a single.
FOUR! A tennis-like forehand smash from Roach. Back of a length on off, Kemar stays leg side and heaves it aerially through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Overpitches searching for the yorker, Bishoo clears his front leg and drills this straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Short of a good length on middle and off, Devendra rises and keeps it down right under his nose.
FOUR! On the pads again, Bishoo takes a step out and flicks it down and across the fine leg boundary. The 300 up for Windies, they will be mighty pleased with this.
The cutter from Shami. A length ball on the stumps, Bishoo backs away to push it on the off side but gets an edge which falls short of Dhoni.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Spills it on the pads, a flick from Bishoo finds the man at mid-wicket.
Bumper outside off, Roach once again tries to take the pull on but the bounce gets too big on him this time.
Goes square this time. Places it well through point and comes back for the second.
Defended down on the leg side from the front foot.
SIX! What a hit from Roach. Khaleel bangs it short, Roach goes back, takes the pull on and connects well enough. Clears the cow corner and earns a maximum to his name.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Serves it on a length around off, Roach defends from inside the crease.
Khaleel Ahmed to have a change of ends.
Full and darted on off, shaping away, drilled straight to the man at extra cover.
Works it off his pads, behind square leg for a run.
Wide! Attempts the yorker but misses. Ends up spilling it down the leg and a wide is signalled.
Length ball on off, blocked from within the crease.
Tad short, on middle and leg, Bishoo moves inside the line to flick it fine but it goes off his thigh pad. Dhoni chases it down and a leg bye is taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Short of a good length outside off, Roach plays it to point. Seeing Bishoo out of his crease, he kind of has an unnecessary shy at the bowler's end. The ball ricochets off the stumps and the batsmen take a single.
Mohammed Shami to bowl now.
Tight stuff. Length delivery on off, Bishoo can only block it down towards mid on.
Some reverse for Umesh. Fullish on off, it takes the inside edge and goes to backward square leg as the batsmen cross over.
Positions himself well behind the line of this short ball and wrists it wide of mid on for a single.
Dabbed to point with an open face again. Dot ball this time.
Some room offered outside off, shorter in length, steered square through point for a run.
Length delivery straightening off the deck on off, Roach is squared up as he defends this out.
Umesh Yadav back on.
Full in length and coming back in, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full in length and outside off, pushed through the covers. One run collected.
Switches the angle to around the wicket and fires it full outside off, almost a yorker in fact. Roach can't dig it out.
Three from three now. Bishoo slaps it past the diving point fielder and gets to the other end.
Uses the angle away from him as he plays this late. Opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Angling back in on the pads, worked away into the leg side for a comfortable single.
Roach has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The googly outside off, spins in, Roach comes forward and defends.
Goes with the spin and turns it behind square leg for one.
The straighter one again, on middle and off, Roach plays it off the inner half on the leg side and takes a single to get off strike.
Kemar Roach is the new man in.

OUT! Exactly what the Windies didn't want. They've lost their skipper at the absolute wrong time. Looped up on middle and leg, it goes on straight as Holder gets low and across to sweep it down fine. But, much to his demise, he goes too far across and exposes his leg stump. The bails are disturbed and that's the end of him.
Spinning in from around off, Bishoo gets low and drags the slog sweep through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Stays back and keeps it out with the full face of the bat.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Wide! Short and well outside off, wide signalled because it's too short.
Slower bouncer, in line of the stumps, pulled with a little swivel through mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Full and angling in on the pads, too easy for Bishoo who tickles it fine down the leg side. Beats Dhoni's dive and finds the fine leg fence.
Short and wide outside off, cut through square on the off side for a single.

NOT OUT! Bishoo just manages to get his foot back in time. A leg spinner outside off, Bishoo is forward to drive it but cannot make contact. Dhoni takes the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it up and after a couple of replays gives it not out.
Touch and go! Dhoni has taken off the bails and Bishoo is the man in question.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Just wide. Loopy ball on off, Holder just chips it past Jadeja to his left.
Slower ball, the batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

DROPPED AND FOUR! The poor fielding from India continues. Loopy ball on leg, Holder mistimes his swing towards mid-wicket. Pant hares to his right and should have taken it easily. To make matters worse he kicks it to the ropes.
Gives this air on off, Holder is solid in defense.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Bishoo is happy to block it out.
Holder has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
FOUR. Making a case for him to bat high up the order. Full on off, Holder lofts it over covers for a boundary. Deliberately done that.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR. Off spinner outside off, Holder goes for the sweep but gets it off his glove towards third man. The ball races to the fence.
Powerplay 3 time. 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Tossed up ball around off, Holder drives it through mid off to retain the strike.
Full and on leg again, hit past mid on to give his skipper the strike.
Full on leg, DB works it down the leg side.
Devendra Bishoo is the new man in.

OUT! Three reds! The original decision stands. Slider on middle, it goes on straight and Nurse does not read it. Gets caught in front of the stumps and the umpire raises his finger after the players put in an appeal. Nurse takes the review after having a chat with his partner and replay shows three reds. He is gone!
LBW review! Ashley Nurse is caught leg before and has opted for the DRS. Looks out to the naked eye.
Turn! Leg spinner on off, Nurse gets a genuine edge past the slip fielder towards third man for a couple of runs.
Short ball on off, Holder stays back and punches it to the off side to get off strike.
Yuzvendra Chahal returns.
Jason has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by Holder presenting the full face of the bat.
Ashley Nurse is in.

OUT! Hetmyer is out of here! A fabulous innings comes to an end. Oh! He will be disappointed. Had a chance to make it even bigger today. Was striking the ball sweetly. He walks back dejected, his skipper pats him on the back, appreciating his effort. Jadeja gives this air on middle and leg, Shimron goes for the sweep but gets a top edge which flies to backward square leg. Pant settles under it and makes no mistake. The young batsman would have wanted to finish things off.
Darts this into Holder who is happy to give the strike to Hetmyer towards mid on.
Off spinner on middle and leg, hit past mid on for one.
Short ball outside off, hit back to Jaddu.
Full and on leg, SH flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! What a way to get to your 3rd ODI ton. Take a bow, Hetmyer. He gets a warm applause from the crowd and the Indian players as well. Thoroughly deserved too. Superb knock from the youngster. Full and outside off, Shimron gives room and lofts this over covers for a maximum. Takes out his helmet and soaks in the applause.
Full outside off, guided to backward point. Stays on 98.
Injury! Hetmyer is receiving medical attention on his shoulder. The physio is out, a few exercises along with the magic spray and he looks fine to continue.
Drags his length back a bit on leg, worked to the on side for one. Hetmyer gets hit on his shoulder as the throw comes in to the striker's end while he's completing the run. Looks to be in pain.

FOUR! What a shot! Glorious! Overpitched from Shami in line of the stumps, Holder plays a straight drive which is so pleasing to the eye. No one moves. The 50-run stand too comes up with his delightful stroke.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Outside off, Holder waits for it and then guides it through short third man for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for one more.
Down leg, played with the turn around the corner for one.
Off spinner on off, Shimron hits it to mid on.
Short ball outside off, Hetmyer drives it to mid off.
Length around off, Holder drives it to mid off. 7 runs off the over. Partnership 38 of 33 balls.
Full and in line of the stumps, hit to long on for one.
Wide.  The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.

FOUR! Nicely played. Adjusted to the ball very well and will get a boundary to his name. Short ball down leg, Hetmyer pulls it with control towards deep backward square leg. Chahal hares to his left and should have stopped that. Moves to 94.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
That kept low. Length outside off, Holder looks to play it with a straight bat but the ball goes under his bat.
Full on middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Mohammed Shami in for another spell.
A bit short again down leg, pulled through square leg for a brace.
SIX! Short ball, very short outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket for a huge biggie.
Slower ball in line of the stumps, hit to mid on.
Bowls this outside off, punched through covers. One more run taken.
Short again outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for just one.
Half tracker down leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, rushes into Holder who gets a top edge while trying to pull it. The ball falls towards short fine leg where they take a run.
Gets it past mid off for one this time.
Full and on off again, driven to mid off.
FOUR! What timing! There was a short third man and a backward point. Umesh lands this full outside off, Hetmyer guides it in that gap for a good-looking boundary.
Aiming the top of off stump, the ball takes the inside edge and rolls in front of square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, defended out from inside the crease.
Through the gap in the covers this time, single taken.
Full and straight, driven back to the bowler.
Once again it's pushed tamely to the covers.
Quicker through the air, goes off the inside edge and rolls to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed to the covers off the front foot.
Flighted on off, Holder comes forward to defend.
DRINKS!
200 up for Windies. They look good to get to the 300-run mark. Short ball down leg, Hetmyer pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Low full toss on off, Hetmyer drives it towards the bowler. It takes a deflection off Holder's bat and goes towards long on. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
FOUR! SHOT! Hetmyer is on song. Full and outside off, Hetmyer drives this through extra cover for a boundary.
Played with an angled bat towards third man for one.
Length ball on that fourth stump line, Holder taps it to the off side.
Length ball outside off, cut to deep point to get to the other end.
Loopy ball on off, played with a straight bat.
Short ball outside off, punched towards mid off to give his skipper the strike.
Holder is up and running. Turns this towards square leg for one.
Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! There is the wicket! Jadeja is all fired up. A needless shot from Powell though. Slider on middle, keeps going down with the angle as Rovman goes for the big swing. Misses it completely though. He looks back to see his leg pole gone. The 74-run stand is finally broken.
Full and down leg, SH flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Very nice shot! Short and wide outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. So much balance on that one.
FOUR! Short of a length on off stump, Powell stands his ground and heaves it over mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep, but it's well wide of him.
Fired full on middle and leg, blocked by bringing his bat ahead of his pads.
Pushes this into the covers and jogs across to the other end.
FOUR LEG BYES! Way too straight, on the hips, all Hetmyer has to do is tickle it fine down the leg side which he does, off the thigh pad though. Another boundary.
Touch fuller and around off, lofted over covers. Two runs are taken, Hetmyer is charging for the third, but on seeing Rovman not that interested, he turns back.
Length delivery angling across, Hetmyer looks to cut but misses.
Umesh Yadav brought back into the attack.
Flicked away through the mid-wicket region. One run added to the total.
Presses well forward to this one and dead-bats it.
Looped up on middle, blocked back down the track.
Another misfield, another run. Worked down to short fine leg where Shami makes the error. A single is stolen.
Quicker through the air again, on the pads, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Quicker one attacking the stumps, the right-hander plays it by going deep inside the crease.
SIX! Ending the over with style. Shortish delivery, on middle and leg, right in Hetmyer's slot. He gets his front leg out of the way and muscles the pull over the cow corner.
Yorker fired in on middle and leg, dug out in front of square leg. Straight to the fielder there.
The single brings up the 50-run stand between this pair. Powell opens the bat face and guides it to third man. Going on strong so far, both will want to make it count.
Slower one outside off, Rovman lets it go.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff from Rovman Powell. A bit on the shorter side of the length, around off, Powell stands firm and blasts it back down the ground for a boundary.
Angling into the batsman, he flicks it through the vacant square leg area for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to short third man.
A peach from Chahal. Slows this one up and lands the leg break on a driving length on off, Powell looks to defend from within the crease but gets beaten. The ball just misses the off stick as well.
Fifty for Shimron Hetmyer! His 2nd in this format. Been completely on song since he's walked out to the middle. Dances down the track and drives it to long on for a single.
Good effort from the Indian skipper. Hetmyer flicks it to the right of Kohli at short mid-wicket but he moves quickly and stops it with a tumble.
Spinning in once more, flicked but straight to short mid-wicket.
Spinning in on the pads, Hetmyer turns it in front of square leg. Runs the first one hard and as a result, is able to come back for the second.
Yuzvendra Chahal is called back on.
FOUR! He can't. Provides too much room outside off, Powell stands his ground and flays this through point, beating the sweeper to the fence.
Good over so far. Dabbed to point with an open face straight to point. Can Khaleel finish well?
Going across once more, the cutter this time, Rovman defends it down in front of point. No run taken.
On the shorter side of things, Powell mistimes the punch and ends up slapping it down to mid off.
Going away on a good length, outside off, Rovman lets it go.
Back of a length angling back in on leg, pulled aerially to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Khaleel Ahmed back into the attack.
Sloppy from Khaleel. Neither Dhoni, nor Kohli are happy about that. Hetmyer flicks it to deep mid-wicket, where a misfield from the fielder there allows the batsmen to take three.
Drives this full ball on the stumps through to long off for one.
Goes off the leading edge just wide of the cover fielder and Hetmyer sneaks a quick single in.
Sliding across as Jadeja darts it outside off, Shimron punches it to covers.
Flat and short, punched down to long on for one more.
Slower and on off, wristed to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
Ends the over by taking a run. Guides this past point to retain strike.
FOUR! 10 runs off 2 balls. Full on leg, Hetmyer gives room and hits this along the turf toward long on for a boundary.
SIX! SHOT! Hetmyer is in some form. Length ball on middle and leg, Shimron clears his front leg and smokes this over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Played to the point region by RP. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Top edge and a boundary. Another perfect bouncer from Shami. Powell is not committed on his pull and gets a small edge which flies well over Dhoni to the third man boundary.
Length ball on the pads of Hetmyer who tucks it to fine leg for one.
SH flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! On middle and leg, Hetmyer goes low and sweeps it over square leg for a biggie. On the previous ball, Dhoni told Jadeja to bowl this outside off...
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Taped towards backward point to get off strike.
Inside edge. Faster one this outside off, Powell gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Slower ball on off, played with a straight bat by Powell.
Short this time, Hetmyer throws his front leg out of the way and pulls it through mid-wicket for two more.
Quite full, almost a yorker on middle and leg, flicked into the leg side for a double.
Rovman Powell to bat next.

OUT! Top edge and gone! Good short ball from Shami as he bangs this in on off. Hope is in no position to play the pull, he still goes for it and gets a big top edge which lobs on the leg side. Dhoni runs to it, gets under it and takes a simple catch. Both the set batsmen for the Windies are back in the dressing room. Two new men in the middle, will have to start from scratch.
Shortish delivery on leg, the left-hander moves across with a little swivels to pull but it goes off his body behind on the leg side. A leg bye is taken as Dhoni moves to cut it off.
Big swing and a big miss from Hetmyer. Length ball angling across, Shimron looks to bash this away but fails to make any kind of connection.
Full delivery aiming the off stump, driven down through mid on for a single.
Mohammed Shami comes back on to bowl.
Lovely. Opened bat face towards backward point for one more. 10 runs of the over.
Smart batting. Follows the six with the rotation of strike. Pulls this to long on for a run.
SIX! HUGE! Very well hit. Tossed up ball outside off, Shimron hits it with the turn and deposits this over long on for a maximum.
Darts this in line of the stumps, turned to square leg.
Bowls this flatter on off, hit to long on to rotate strike.
Short ball again outside off, punched to long off for an easy run.
Brings out the broom. Full and on middle and leg, Shimron sweeps it to deep square leg for a brace.
SH flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! 100 for Windies. Short ball asking to be hit, Hetmyer gets into position early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Yorker on leg, Hope has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Similar ball, this time Hope gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Hope gets forward and blocks it out.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
Tossed up ball outside off, soft leading edge towards point.
Quick single. Floated ball on leg, flicked to square leg for a quick run.
Gives this air in line of the stumps, Hope bunts it down.
Short ball outside off, pulled to long on for one more.
Off spinner around off, driven towards covers for one.
Ravindra Jadeja is called to bowl.
Floated ball on leg, Hetmyer flicks it away.
Tossed up ball on off, Hetmyer defends it getting behind the ball.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and down leg, flicked through square leg for a single. They thought of the second but decide against it.
Milks this through mid on for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Hope plays it with a straight bat.

In the air.... just safe! Hetmyer survives. Slower ball in line of the stumps, Hetmyer was early in his shot and lofts it over mid on. Dhawan hares behind it but just couldn't get to the ball. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Wide. Will have to re bowl that. Goes for the bouncer down leg again. Too far for Hetmyer to make contact.
5 dots in a row. Short ball again this time down leg, Shimron goes for the pull but connects with thin air. Can Khaleel end it well?
Short ball outside off, Hetmyer sways away from it.
Full and outside off again, this time Hetmyer runs it down to backward point.
Full and outside off, Hetmyer looks to drive this but plays a nothing shot. Almost gets his outside edge.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hope punches it through covers for one.
Great over from Chahal. Just the one run from it and a wicket. Bowls this full on off, Hetmyer plays it to the off side.
Another ball given flight. Hetmyer comes ahead and bunts it out.
Leg spinner on middle and off, Hetmyer blocks it out.
Drinks! Meanwhile, Shimron Hetmyer walks out to bat.

OUT! One brings two. Samuels doesn't make it big on his 200th ODI. Chahal gives this air on middle and leg. Marlon gets his front foot forward looking to bunt it down but the ball goes on to hit his leg. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Hope has a chat with Samuels but the umpire says that they have exceeded the 15 seconds. 2 wickets in 2 overs for India and they are back on top.
Turn and bounce! Tossed up ball on middle, Marlon goes for the drive but gets beaten by turn.
Loopy ball on leg, Hope makes room and drives it to long off to give Samuels the strike.
Hope opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single. 3 runs and a wicket from it.
Marlon Samuels is the new man in.

OUT! Powell holes out. Length ball outside off, Powell looks to go downtown. Gets it off the bottom of the bat as his bat turns in his hand and the ball goes towards long off where Dhawan takes it with glee and does his trademark celebration. India will be pleased to see the back of Powell as he was looking dangerous. Partnership of 65 comes to an end.
Hope has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Goes full this time on leg, flicked to square leg by Hope.
Back of a length ball on middle, Hope goes to pull it but gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad.
Length ball, Powell flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Hope takes a big step ahead and blocks it.
Goes for the sweep but fails to make connection. The ball hits his pads and rolls to the on side. They run and collect the leg bye.
Driven towards the mid off region by Shai. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stifled appeal which dies down. Leg spinner on leg, Hope looks to block it but get hits on the pad. Perhaps pitched outside and missing leg too.
9th ODI fifty for Kieran Powell. Really well played. Leg spinner in line of the stumps, Powell flicks it to the on side to get to the landmark. He'll want to continue and score big.
Slower ball on middle and leg, Powell flicks it through square leg for a single. Good comeback over from Khaleel.
Full and on off, driven towards mid off.
Slower ball on leg, Hope works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Similar line on the off pole, Hope guides it to the point fielder.
Outside off, closer to the off pole, Hope taps it in front of him.
Full and wide outside off, going away from Hope. He looks to drive it but cannot make any contact.
Dot ball to finish. Worked away on the leg side for nothing. Expensive first over from Chahal, 11 off it.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Worked away in front of square leg and takes a single.
SIX! That's outta here! Floated and full on middle and leg, Powell is down on one knee as he brings out the big slog sweep. Clears square leg and sends it into the stands.
The 50-run stand is up. A good recovery from these two. Powell gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.
Tossed up on middle and off, Hope opens his body up and drives it through to wide long off for a single.
Spin now introduced. Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over.

Is that out? Dhoni and Khaleel look interested, but then opt out of it. Angling back in on middle and leg, keeps going further down and catches Powell on the pads. Loud appeal ensues, but nothing follows. Maybe the Indians realized it was going above the stumps.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The Umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Poor from Shami. Should be stopping that. Powell takes a step out and smacks it towards mid off. Shami moves to his left but it bursts through his fingers to travel to the boundary line behind.
Short of a good length just outside off, pulled through mid-wicket. One run collected.
Hangs on the back foot and defends it with a straight blade.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid on for a run.
Too high. Back of a length on middle and leg, Powell goes back to pull but gets rapped on the thigh pad. No real appeal made for lbw, only a half-hearted one.
Powerplay 2 signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Strays on the pads, flicked through square leg for another single. A good Powerplay for Windies after the early stutter. They are 59/1 at the end of it.
Waits for the ball to come, plays this very late and dabs it behind point for one.
Drives it again towards mid off, but can't beat the fielder this time.

FOUR! Well, I take it back. Now this is the shot of the match. Will be very difficult to top that. Full and just outside off, Shai Hope leans into the shot and just plays a punchy-drive through the left of mid off. Elegantly done.
On the fourth stump channel, blocked down square on the off side.
Too straight in line, flicked off the pads through backward square leg for a double.
FOUR! Good end to the over. Short of a length just outside off, Powell gets into position early and muscles the pull over wide mid on to find the fence. The 50 comes up for Windies.
A run results from a misfield. Hope punches it to point, Pant fumbles and the batsmen take off. There is a throw at the bowler's end but it misses.
Angling across, on a good length, Hope looks to push it away on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Works this full delivery just wide of mid on and changes ends.
FOUR! Superb. Too much room on offer from Khaleel, Powell can go back and crack this through the gap in the covers. Nobody bothered chasing after it, was hit so well.
Length delivery just outside off, played back in the bowler's direction.
First bowling change. Inside Powerplay 1 itself. Khaleel Ahmed is brought into the attack.
On a length, on off, pushed firmly down the ground towards mid off.
Blocks it away towards point from the back foot.

FOUR! That's a stunning shot. Best of the innings so far. Beautiful from Shai Hope. Back of a length outside off, this time he finds the gap to perfection. Rises on his toes and gets it between point and cover-point with a punch. Boundary results.
Targets the top of off stump with a length delivery, dabbed with an open face to backward point.
Length ball in the off stump channel, blocked from inside the crease.
Wide! Too far outside off, across the tramline, wide signalled by the umpire.
Fires it full on middle and leg, it's wristed straight to the man at mid on.
SIX! That's a big one! The slower one from Shami, full and outside off. Powell picks it up and lofts it well over long off. Clears the fence with no problem and that's the first maximum of the game.
Cramps him for room this time. Length ball on middle and leg with some inward movement, the southpaw can only force it away on the off side.
Width offered outside off, Kieran should have put this away. Instead he can just find the cover-point fielder with the cut shot.
Could have dragged it on, just like Hemraj. Back of a length outside off, Powell goes back to play the big pull over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Takes some of the pace off this, bowls it on a length on middle and off. Powell hangs his bat out and gets a leading edge which rolls to cover-point.
FOUR! Nicely done. Length ball too straight in line, Powell from inside the crease heaves it past square leg. Debutant Pant hares after it, but only comes second best.
Dot ball to end the sixth over. Back of a length outside off, Hope is on his toes and pushes it towards point.
Didn't take the run on that occasion. Strange. Powell the one refusing it. Hope dabs it just wide of the diving point fielder, Shai wants the run but Kieran sends him back.
Keeps it around off, Hope defends it down in front of point.
Angling in on a good length, Hope wrists it away but straight to mid-wicket.
Marginally behind a length, on off, kept out from inside the crease.

Should have been stopped, at least by Kohli's standards. Kieran Powell drives this full ball outside off to mid off. The Indian skipper there moves to his left, dives but it goes through his palms. Three runs result.

Hope drives this to the right of mid on. The fielder there moves to his right, collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. Misses and Dhoni can't collect it cleanly. So the batsmen take one more on the overthrow.
Short of a good length outside off, some room on offer so Powell goes back and steers it down towards third man. Single taken.
Hope is off the mark without wasting any time. On middle and off, he works it in front of square leg and gets to the other end.
Shai Hope is next in at no.3.

OUT! He's dragged it on. Chandrapaul Hemraj's ODI debut got off to a fine start, but it's ended rather abruptly. Back of a length around off, holds its line and Hemraj decides to take on the pull shot. He swivels, swings but gets a bottom edge which crashes back into the stumps. First breakthrough for India, a timely one for them too. The two openers were finding good rhythm.
Full in line of the stumps, driven to mid on.

Doesn't carry! Powell plays that with soft hands, to his credit. Length ball on off, a hint of shape away, Powell hangs his bat, gets an edge and it falls short of a diving Shikhar Dhawan at first slip. It goes through him and a single is taken.
Fuller in length and just outside off, pushed on the off side to end the over.
Doesn't move his feet much. Hangs back to the length ball and meets it with the full face.
Moving away from the batsman on a good length, Hemraj lets it go.
Good running. Pushes this length ball to the left of mid on and calls for it. Both batsmen take off and complete the run as Khaleel can't get to the ball quick enough.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Better line. Length ball on middle and off, Powell stays behind the line and blocks.
FOUR! Three consecutive boundary for Windies now. Umesh serves it on the pads, Powell flicks it ever so well through backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries to end the over. Short and wide, Hemraj rises on his toes and cuts it behind point to find the fence.

FOUR! Stylish from Hemraj. Taking full advantage of the Powerplay. Full and on the stumps, the left-hander lofts it straight back over the bowler's head with the full face of the bat. Holds the pose for the cameras too as a boundary results.
Loud appeal, but pitching outside leg. Shami lands it on a length and Chandrapaul looks to lift it over the leg side. Misses and is caught on the pads. He's lucky it pitching where it did.
Just ahead of a length, on off, comes half-forward and defends it on the off side.
Beaten! A bit of a loosener from Shami, full and outside off, tempting the debutant to play at it. He does so, comes forward for the drive and gets beaten past the outside edge due to the away swing.
Rising off the deck from a good length, close to off, Hemraj stays back and defends.
Shaping away from around off, a play and a miss from Powell.
Leading edge but it's safe. Landing around off and coming back in, Powell hangs his bat out and gets it off the leading edge on his attempted flick. It goes towards backward point.
And the debutant is off the mark in ODI cricket. Back of a length on the hips, Hemraj clips it down towards fine leg and takes a single.
Fraction straight in line, worked down on the leg side.
A nice, solid push from the debutant. Good length delivery outside off, Hemraj takes a big stride forward and places it towards wide mid off.
Back of a length cutting back in on middle and leg, Hemraj stays back and keeps it out back down the track.
Umesh Yadav to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good come back from Shami after being hit for a boundary on the first ball. Serves this full around off, Kieran gets it off his inner half onto his pads and back to the bowler.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands this a bit full outside off, Powell hits it to the on side.
Back of a length ball coming into KP who misses his tuck to get hit on the thigh pad.
Angles this into the hips of Powell at 143 kph. Kieran goes for the pull but gets hit on his body. No damage done.
Drags his length back a bit around off, Powell bunts it down.
FOUR! What a start. Welcome to white-ball cricket. Overpitched ball outside off, Powell leans ahead and drives it ever so well through covers for a boundary.

Done and dusted. The Indians are out on the field and take their positions. Kieran Powell and debutant Chandrapaul Hemraj will open for the visitors while Mohammed Shami will start with the new ball. Two slips for him. Here we go...
The players make their way out for their respective national anthems. We are moments away now...

Jason Holder, the Windies skipper says that he would have batted first. Mentions that they have an opportunity to put runs on the board. Adds saying that they are a young side as few players are missing. On his team, he says that they have handed Oshane Thomas and Chandrapaul Hemraj their debuts.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper says that it is a good and hard surface. Reckons that the pitch won't change much so he decides to field first. Mentions that their batting order is pretty much settled now and wants them to make big partnerships. Ends by saying that Rishabh Pant gets his debut and they are playing with 2 spinners and 3 pacers.
TOSS - Virat Kohli wins the coin toss and opts to field.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop doing the pitch report mentions that there is brown grass on the surface with plenty of cracks. Sunil Gavaskar alongside him says that there will be turn for the spinners but the ball will skid as well. Adds that the pitch is hard from underneath and the cracks will open up later. Reckons that it is a bat first pitch. Ends by saying that there won't be any dew later on as the game should end before that.

You'd bank on Windies to do better in white-ball cricket. Though, they have key players missing. In the absence of people like Chris Gayle, Sunil Narine, Andre Russell and Evin Lewis, the task is going to be an uphill one. They do have some positives, however, with Shimron Hetmyer being one of them. They will have to muster all their courage, bind together and perform as a collective. Let's see how it all unfolds. The toss and other updates coming up soon...

Any games in the 50-over format will be important for all the teams now with the upcoming World Cup in 2019. India have a more or less settled batting order, barring that no.4 position, which Ambati Rayudu now seems the front runner for. They have strength in depth and will want to test that too, if they decide to rest some players, that is. They beat the Windies comprehensively in the Test series, and will want to continue further with that. Hello and welcome for what should be a better contest between these two sides.
